items.jobTitle: Ingénieur Bancs de Test HIL Hardware & Validation Système Propulsion (H/F)
items.jobDescription:
Au sein d'un programme spatial ambitieux et innovant, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Bancs de Test Hardware. 
 Dans un contexte de forte criticité technique et de phase montante du cycle en V, vous intervenez pour garantir la validation de l'électronique embarquée, du contrôleur, des systèmes de commande, des actionneurs et des plateformes hardware associées.
 Vous intégrez une équipe dynamique et collaborative, avec des homologues techniques basés à l'international en appui si besoin.
 Missions principales
 Conception & Architecture Hardware : Concevoir, construire et maintenir l'environnement de test Hardware du système de propulsion (du niveau carte contrôleur moteur jusqu'au sous-système intégré), avec un souci permanent de robustesse et de scalabilité.
 Architecture HW / SW : Définir et implémenter l'architecture matérielle et logicielle du banc Hardware (conditionnement des signaux, matériel d'insertion de charge et de défaut, cibles temps réel).
 Modélisation & Simulation : Intégrer des modèles de plante temps réel dans NI VeriStand et boucler avec l'ECU (alimentation, vannes, pompes, moteurs, chambre de combustion, comportement thermique).
 Émulation : Émuler et simuler les capteurs (pressions, thermocouples, RTD, débitmètres, rétroactions) et actionneurs (pilotes de vannes, inverseurs, igniteurs) avec des caractéristiques électriques de vol.
 Développement & Automatisation : Développer des applications LabVIEW (desktop, temps réel et FPGA) avec des interfaces bus (CAN, RS-422/485, Ethernet) et définir les workflows d'automatisation des tests.
 Validation & FDIR : Mettre en place l'injection de défauts (électrique et modèle) pour vérifier les séquences critiques (démarrage, arrêt, abort ) et le comportement FDIR .
 Campagnes d'Essais : Soutenir l'exécution des tests, l'acquisition de données, le logging, le reporting automatisé et corréler les modèles avec l'équipe propulsion.
 Évolution & Qualité : Contribuer à l'évolution continue de l'infrastructure Hardware (performance, fiabilité, maintenabilité), maintenir la documentation technique et garantir la configuration sous contrôle selon les standards spatiaux (ECSS ou équivalents aéro).
 Environnement technique & outils
 Logiciels mandatory : Labview et National Instruments 
 Frameworks : Simulink, FMU, LabVIEW FPGA, NI TestStand, Python, C/C++.
 Matériel : Hardware NI, FPGA, systèmes temps réel, matériel d'insertion de défauts.
 Protocoles & Bus : CAN, RS-422/485, Ethernet.
 Standards : ECSS (ou équivalent aéronautique type DO-178C).
 Profil recherché
 Formation : Bachelor ou Master en Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Control Engineering, Computer Science ou domaine technique équivalent.
 Expérience : Une première expérience validée (idéalement 2 à 3 ans) sur des bancs Hardware en boucle fermée pour des systèmes de contrôle complexes (idéalement en propulsion liquide ou secteurs exigeants).
 Solides bases en intégration hardware/software et systèmes temps réel.
 Anglais obligatoire (environnement international).
 Approche rigoureuse, méthodique, structurée et orientée sécurité.
 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 
 AYES est une société internationale italienne, spécialisée dans le conseil en ingénierie, avec comme spécialité l'innovation.
 Avec plusieurs implantations en Europe et aux Etats-Unis, et forte d'une importante croissance ces dernières années, AYES s'est implantée en France et plus particulièrement dans le Sud-Ouest avec une toute nouvelle agence à Toulouse !
 Notre société s'articule autour des valeurs humaines, du bien-être au travail, de la proximité avec les collaborateurs et les clients. Nos managers sont pour la plupart d'anciens consultants ; ils possèdent une expérience technique et pratique du terrain, et des différentes situations inhérentes. Ils possèdent une connaissance du tissu industriel local.
 Aujourd'hui le visage d'AYES se dessine autour d'une équipe professionnelle mais surtout familiale et conviviale, où la bonne humeur et la confiance sont les maîtres mots.
 Notre défi et objectif est à la fois d'offrir des services plus personnalisés et de meilleure qualité à nos clients, et de proposer à nos collaborateurs, des opportunités d'évolution concrètes en lien avec leurs souhaits.
 Notre inspiration :
 « Notre projet s'est largement constitué autour des ambitions de nos collaborateurs Nous mettons en œuvre tout ce qui peut l'être dans l'objectif de concrétiser vos souhaits. Nous sommes convaincus que ce que nous VOULONS vraiment, ENSEMBLE, nous POUVONS le faire ». (Danilo SPADA, cofondateur d'AYES)
 Nous accompagnons nos clients (Grands Comptes et PME) dans leurs démarches d'ingénierie et de R&D via une approche multisectorielle (pôles Transports, Industrie, Energie, Life science et Numérique) permettant à nos équipes d'évoluer dans un contexte riche et polyvalent !
 AYES est un groupe à la fois dynamique, agile, international et bien structuré : vous pouvez ainsi bénéficier de l'esprit start-up et de la force d'un groupe solide.

items.jobTitle: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Starte deine Leadership Journey im Bereich R&D
items.jobDescription:
Bereit, die Zukunft der Technologie zu gestalten?  Wir suchen visionäre und technikbegeisterte Master-Graduates und PhDs mit Gestaltungswillen, die im Junior Managers Program die Zukunft der Mobilitäts- und Energiesysteme, die nächste Generation smarter, vernetzter Systeme oder die Welt der angewandten künstlichen Intelligenz neu erfinden. Du liebst technologische Herausforderungen, denkst strategisch und willst als zukünftige Führungskraft die digitale und physische Welt von Bosch verändern? Dann möchten wir von dir hören.​
 Über eine intensive Reise von 12–24 Monaten wirst du Teil unserer R&D-Organisation. Du rotierst durch verschiedene Bereiche in Deutschland und weltweit, sammelst wertvolle Auslandserfahrung und übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Arbeitspakete entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette.
 Du wirst nicht nur unterstützen – du wirst entwickeln, entscheiden und führen. Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Führungskräften und deinem persönlichen Mentor auf Managementebene legst du den Grundstein für deine Karriere im technologischen Führungsumfeld von Bosch.
 Was Du bei uns lernen und entwickeln wirst: ​ 
 Im Rahmen des Programms arbeitest du schwerpunktmäßig in einem der folgenden drei technologischen Bereiche. 
 Hardware & Systems Engineering:  Du tauchst tief in das internationale Entwicklungsnetzwerk für automobile Steuergeräte ein. Du begleitest die gesamte Hardware-Entwicklungskette: von Schaltungsdesign, Leistungselektronik und Halbleitern über Simulation, Verifikation und EMV-Prüfung bis hin zur Industrialisierung und dem Lifecycle-Management.​
 Software, IoT & Smart Systems: Du gestaltest die Zukunft smarter Thermotechnik- und Raumklimalösungen. Dabei arbeitest du an Zukunftstechnologien wie KI, IoT, Embedded Software, Data Science, Cloud-Architekturen oder entwickelst komplexe mechatronische Systemarchitekturen und Steuerungs-/Regelungssysteme.​
 Applied Artificial Intelligence & Robotics: Du treibst die Implementierung von künstlicher Intelligenz in realen Systemen voran. Du entwickelst KI-Agenten, wendest Data Science und Data Engineering im Engineering-Prozess an und bringst AI direkt in Embedded Systems und hochinnovative Produktentwicklungen ein.
 Führungskompetenz als verbindendes Element:  Unabhängig von deinem fachlichen Schwerpunkt entwickelst du über alle Stationen hinweg deine Führungskompetenzen weiter . Du lernst, interdisziplinäre und internationale Teams zu koordinieren, Schnittstellen zu Fertigung, Einkauf, Software und Kunden zu steuern und komplexe technologische Projekte agil zum Erfolg zu führen.
Dein akademisches Fundament: Sehr gut abgeschlossenes Vollzeitmaster- oder Diplomstudium, idealerweise Promotion, im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Maschinenbau, Robotik, Mechatronik, Physik, Mathematik, Software- oder Chemie-/Verfahrens-/Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung mit entsprechenden fachlichen Schwerpunkten. 
 Deine Begeisterung für mechatronische und digitale Systeme: Dein Ziel ist es, die technische und kommerzielle Machbarkeit neuer Produktgenerationen zu bewerten und bis zur Serienreife zu führen – sei es bei innovativen Antriebs-, Thermo- und Wasserstofftechnologien, zukunftsweisenden IoT- und Raumklimalösungen oder bei der direkten Integration von Applied AI und KI-Agenten.
 Dein Blick für das große Ganze: Du findest es faszinierend, komplexe Zusammenhänge über Funktionsgrenzen hinweg zu analysieren, funktionale Schnittstellen (z. B. Entwicklung, Fertigung, Einkauf, Qualität, Kunden und Vertrieb) zu koordinieren und innovative Systemarchitekturen optimal auf die Anforderungen globaler Märkte auszurichten.
 Dein Verständnis für Human-centric Leadership: Du lebst die Überzeugung, dass herausragende Ergebnisse nur durch die Befähigung von Menschen entstehen. Mit emotionaler Intelligenz und Empathie schaffst du ein Umfeld, in dem interdisziplinäre und internationale Teams ihr volles Potenzial entfalten und gemeinsam erfolgreich sind.
 Du denkst strategisch und gestaltest die Zukunft: Du erkennst das große Ganze und leitest aus Marktanforderungen kritische technische KPIs sowie zukunftsweisende R&D-Roadmaps ab. Du besitzt starke Analysefähigkeiten und die Leidenschaft für "Hands-on"-Programmierung und Prompting, um innovative Konzepte (z. B. in Matlab, Python, C, Java oder mittels KI-Modellen) eigenständig zu erarbeiten und zu bewerten.
 Deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung: Du setzt in unserem dynamischen Umfeld deine Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen, täglich ein und entwickelst dich so kontinuierlich weiter – ein Growth-Mindset, das wir aktiv fördern.
 Deine sprachliche Gewandtheit: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Englisch und beherrschst die deutsche Sprache (oder bringst die Bereitschaft mit, diese schnell auszubauen), um dich in unserem internationalen und lokalen Umfeld sicher zu bewegen. Mindestens drei Monate Auslandserfahrung sowie eine hohe Mobilität runden dein Profil ab.
Warum du es lieben wirst, Teil unserer Community zu sein ​
Wir sind tief in das Wachstum unserer Teammitglieder investiert. Wir haben eine Umgebung geschaffen, in der du unterstützt, geschätzt und befähigt wirst, deine beste Arbeit zu leisten. ​
 ​
 Mentoring & Sponsoring:  Ein Mentor aus der Führungsebene begleitet dich auf deinem Weg, fördert aktiv deine Entwicklung und öffnet dir Türen für deine nächsten Karriereschritte bei uns.​
 Eine Kultur der Zugehörigkeit:  Vom ersten Tag an wirst du Teil einer globalen Community von Trainees aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und Standorten. Baue authentische Verbindungen über formale Projekte hinaus durch virtuelle Treffen, lokale Meetups oder unsere (globalen) Trainee-Gipfel. ​
 Flexibles & hybrides Arbeiten:  Wir vertrauen dir, deine Arbeit so zu managen, dass sie zu deinem Leben passt, mit einem flexiblen Startdatum und einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag. Wir bieten ein hybrides Modell, das Büro- und Remote-Zusammenarbeit kombiniert. ​
 Kontinuierliches Lernen:  Profitiere von 4-6 Rotationen in verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen, einschließlich einer Rotation im Ausland mit einem großzügigen Budget für berufliche Entwicklung, einschließlich Kursen, Zertifizierungen und Konferenzen. ​
 Bist du bereit, mit uns die Zukunft im Bereich R&D Mobilhydraulik​ zu gestalten? Bewirb dich jetzt und sag uns, warum du der perfekte Kandidat bist, um die digital Revolution zu leiten.
 Du hast Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess? 
Claudia Mertens-Baaij (Personalabteilung)
Telefon: 0711 811 7200
 Unser Bewerbungsprozess für das Junior Managers Program umfasst mehrere Schritte:
Ein telefonisches Interview, ein Assessment Center und ein finales Interview.
 As a globally active company, we are legally required to comply with applicable EU and US (re)export control and sanctions regulations. Therefore, we will ask you to provide further information at a later step in the recruiting process. For details on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Data Protection Notice .

We are looking for a Programmer to support the development of embedded and digital systems through low-level software and hardware description language programming. The Embedded Software Engineer will play a key role in developing, implementing, and validating firmware and FPGA logic for microcontroller- and FPGA-based systems used in advanced R&D and engineering applications.
 Your Responsibilities
 Develop embedded software in the C programming language for microcontroller-based systems
 Design, implement and verify digital logic using hardware description languages such as VHDL or Verilog
 Program, configure and debug field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) for control, data acquisition and signal processing applications
 Develop low-level drivers, interfaces and communication protocols for embedded systems
 Provide support for the setup, debugging, and validation of microcontroller and FPGA platforms
 Work closely with electronics, power electronics and systems engineers to define hardware-software interfaces
 Implement and test real-time control and monitoring functionality
 Use simulation tools, logic analysers, and on-target debugging tools to perform functional verification and debugging
 Document software and FPGA designs, architectures and test procedures
 Maintain and improve existing firmware and FPGA codebases
 Provide support for integration and testing activities in laboratory and R&D environments
 Your Qualifications & Skills
 Degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a closely related field
 Previous professional experience in a similar role
 Strong programming experience in C for embedded systems
 Hands-on experience with HDL programming using VHDL, Verilog, or equivalent
 Experience programming and debugging microcontrollers
 Experience working with FPGAs, including synthesis, implementation, and testing
 Familiarity with development tools such as GCC, vendor IDEs, and FPGA toolchains
 Understanding of digital electronics, timing, and hardware-software interaction
 Experience with communication interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or CAN
 Passion for research and innovation, and a willingness to learn and adapt quickly
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, German is a plus
 OUR COMMITMENT
 Innovative work environment in a young, dynamic team
 High-tech projects in the future-proof sector of e-mobility
 Opportunities for advancement in a growing company
 A wide range of further training opportunities
 Attractive bonus system and performance-related pay
 Additional company benefits 
 WHY ALPITRONIC
 Together with our customers, we are driving the world towards sustainable mobility – with cutting-edge technology, we inspire with the most innovative and reliable solutions. With our roots in South Tyrol, we are market and innovation leaders and set the future charging infrastructure standards from our locations in Bolzano/Bozen, Bergamo, Bologna, Munich and Charlotte (USA). 
 WHAT MAKES WORKING FOR US SPECIAL
 We are excited to meet individuals who are enthusiastic about making things happen, take personal responsibility and appreciate seeing the direct results of their work in the final product. We are a fast-growing company and offer our top teams a diverse and challenging range of tasks in a respectful corporate culture. Your contributions matter, are appreciated and have a significant impact! Join us and be part of our team!

items.jobTitle: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Start your Leadership Journey in R&D
items.jobDescription:
Shape the R&D landscape of the future with us! We are looking for visionary, tech-savvy master’s graduates and PhDs with a drive to make a difference, who will shape the future of mobility and energy systems, develop the next generation of smart, connected system or pioneer the world of applied artificial intelligence in our Junior Managers Program. Do you love technological challenges, think strategically, and want to lead as a future manager in Bosch's digital and physical worlds? Then we want to hear from you.​
 Over an intensive 12 to 24-month journey, you will become part of our global R&D organization. You will rotate through different areas in Germany and worldwide, gain valuable international experience, and take on responsibility for high-impact work packages from day one. Depending on your business unit and focus, you will either design the hardware value chain for automotive control units or drive groundbreaking software, IoT, and system developments for smart homes.
 You won't just support—you will develop, decide, and lead. Together with experienced executives and your personal mentor on management level, you will lay the foundation for your career in Bosch’s technological leadership environment.
 What you will learn and develop with us:​ 
 As part of the program, your work will focus on one of the following three technological areas. 
 Hardware & Systems Engineering:  You will dive deep into the development, industrialization, and commercialization of powertrain and energy solutions – ranging from efficient combustion-engine systems and high-performance thermal management to hydrogen technologies (fuel cells, electrolysis stacks) as well as electronics, software, controls, and components sales.
 Software, IoT & Smart Systems:  You will shape the future of smart thermal technology and room climate solutions. You will work on future technologies like IoT, embedded software, data science, cloud architectures, or develop complex mechatronic system architectures and control systems.
 Applied Artificial Intelligence & Robotics: You will drive the implementation of artificial intelligence into real-world applications. You will design AI agents, utilize data science and data engineering within engineering/product development, and bring hands-on AI capabilities into embedded systems.
 Leadership competence as the unifying element:  Regardless of your technical focus, you will continuously develop your leadership skills across all rotations . You will learn how to coordinate interdisciplinary and international teams, manage interfaces with manufacturing, purchasing, software, and customers, and successfully lead complex technological projects in an agile way.
Your academic foundation: An outstanding full-time Master's degree or Diploma, ideally a PhD, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Physics, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Chemical/Process/Energy Engineering, or a comparable technical field of study with appropriate academic priorities
 Your passion for mechatronic and digital systems: Your goal is to evaluate the technical and commercial feasibility of new product generations and lead them all the way to series production readiness—whether in innovative powertrain, thermal, and hydrogen technologies, connected IoT and room climate solutions, or in integrating applied AI and AI agents directly into embedded systems.
 Your eye for the bigger picture: You find it fascinating to analyze complex relationships across functional boundaries, coordinate functional interfaces (e.g., development, manufacturing, purchasing, quality, customers, and sales), and optimally align innovative system architectures with the requirements of global markets.
 Your understanding of human-centric leadership: You live by the conviction that outstanding results only emerge by empowering people. Utilizing emotional intelligence and empathy, you foster an environment where interdisciplinary and international teams unlock their full potential and succeed together.
 You think strategically and shape the future: You recognize the big picture and derive critical technical KPIs as well as forward-looking R&D roadmaps from market requirements. You bring strong analytical skills and a passion for hands-on programming and prompting to develop and evaluate innovative solution concepts (e.g., in Matlab, Python, C, Java, or utilizing AI models).
 Your continuous development:  In our dynamic environment, you leverage your ability to learn quickly every day, continuously developing yourself—a growth mindset that we actively support and nurture.
 Your language proficiency: You communicate fluently in English (negotiation level) and possess a strong command of the German language (or have the drive to develop it quickly) to navigate confidently within both our international and local environments. At least three months of international experience and high mobility round off your profile.
Why you will love being part of our community 
 We are deeply invested in the growth of our team members. We have created an environment where you are supported, valued, and empowered to do your best work.
 Mentoring & Sponsoring:  An executive-level mentor will accompany you on your journey, actively support your development, and open doors for your next career steps with us.
 A culture of belonging:  From day one, you will become part of a global community of trainees from diverse backgrounds and locations. Build authentic connections beyond formal projects through virtual hangouts, local meetups, or our (global) trainee summits.
 Flexible & hybrid working:  We trust you to manage your work in a way that fits your life, with a flexible start date and a permanent employment contract. We offer a hybrid model that combines office and remote collaboration.
 Continuous learning:  Benefit from up to 6 rotations across different departments, including an international rotation, supported by a generous budget for your professional development (courses, certifications, and conferences).
 Are you ready to shape the future of R&D Powertrain Solutions and Home Comfort with us? Apply now and tell us why you are the perfect candidate to lead the digital revolution.
 Do you have questions about the application process? 
Claudia Mertens-Baaij (Human Resources)
Telephone: 0711 811 7200

a Telephone Interview, Assessment Center and a Final Interview.
 As a globally active company, we are legally required to comply with applicable EU and US (re)export control and sanctions regulations. # Unternehmen
TKMS Hagenuk Marinekommunikation ist ein Unternehmen der TKMS Gruppe. Als führender Anbieter für maritime Funk- und Kommunikationssysteme unterstützen wir Marinen auf der ganzen Welt dabei, die Meere sicherer zu machen. Unser Standort in Flintbek befindet sich in der Nähe von Kiel an der Ostsee. Bereit mit den Besten und als Teil eines Teams aus mehr als 9.700 Kolleginnen und Kollegen, zu arbeiten? Als wachsendes Marineunternehmen bieten wir zukunftssichere Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem internationalen, diversen Hightechumfeld. Wir entwickeln Stärke.
# Aufgaben
- Zukünftige Anwendungen für militärische Kommunikation identifizieren
 - Verantwortung für die Aufbereitung und Verarbeitung digitalisierter Signale, von der Simulation bis zur EmbeddedHardware
 - Erstellung von Spezifikationen für Entwicklungsgegenstände des jeweiligen Fachbereichs sowie Leitung der beauftragten oder eigenständigen Durchführung
 - Aufbau technischer Grundlagen, die neue kommerzielle Entwicklungen ermöglichen
 - Identifikation und Bearbeitung von Forschungsvorhaben
# Profil
- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektro und Informationstechnik, Nachrichtentechnik, Physik oder eines vergleichbaren Studienganges
 - Fundierte Kenntnisse in digitaler Signalverarbeitung (z.B. Filterdesign, FFT, adaptive Verfahren, Modulations/Demodulationsschemata)
 - Erfahrung in hardwarenaher Softwareentwicklung sowie im Umgang mit Entwicklungs und Simulationswerkzeugen wie GNURadio, LabVIEW oder MATLAB/Simulink
 - Praxiskenntnisse im Umgang mit analoger und digitaler Hardware
 - Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Erstellung konzeptioneller Designs und Architekturen für die Informationsübertragung
 - Gute Deutsch und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
# Das bieten wir
Für uns ist es selbstverständlich, optimale Rahmenbedingungen zu bieten. Dazu gehören unter anderem:
 - Welcomeday und Onboardingprogramm
 - Attraktive tarifliche Vergütung
 - Flexible und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeitgestaltung durch Gleitzeitkonto sowie Homeoffice-Regelung
 - 30 Tage Jahresurlaub sowie Sonderurlaub gemäß Tarifvertrag
 - Hervorragende betriebliche Altersversorgung
 - Spannende Aufgaben an innovativen Produkten in einem wachsenden Marineunternehmen
 - Zuschuss zum Jobticket bzw. Deutschlandticket
 - Firmenfitness mit bundesweiten Verbundpartnern
 - Bikeleasing
 - Umfassende Zusatzleistungen / attraktive externe Angebote
 - Individuelle Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in Präsenz und digital
 - Umfassendes Gesundheitsmanagement inkl. Präventionsangebote
 - Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften und der Mitarbeitendenvertretung
Kollegiale Zusammenarbeit und Respekt im Umgang miteinander – das bieten wir seit über 185 Jahren!
Wir freuen uns über Online-Bewerbungen unter Angabe der Gehaltsvorstellung und der aktuellen Kündigungsfrist.

TKMS GmbH
Acquisition und Experience
Barbara Belsch
# Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt
Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/ Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

You will help take devices from epitaxial stack and device design through fabrication with external partners, to characterisation, reliability and qualification.

 Contribute to the design and modelling of III-V active devices, including epitaxial layer structure, gain and power modelling, optical mode design, and electrical and thermal design
 Help define device specifications for your area, translating system requirements into device design and integration targets
 Contribute to mask design and tape-outs, including GDS layouts, test structures and design-of-experiment splits
 Support fabrication runs with external epitaxy and foundry partners: follow process flows, review process and in-line data, and help resolve yield issues as the technology scales
 Contribute to the characterisation strategy at wafer, chip and integrated-PIC level, including building and automating test setups
 Analyse test data, correlate measured performance with design and process variations, and support design iterations to close performance gaps
 Work with packaging and reliability engineers on burn-in, accelerated ageing, failure analysis and qualification
 Share knowledge with colleagues and support the onboarding of new team members as the team grows
 Essential requirements 
 PhD in physics, photonics, electrical engineering, optical engineering or a related subject with 2+ years’ relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 4+ years’ relevant experience, including at least 2 years’ hands-on development of III-V optical amplifiers or semiconductor lasers, preferably in industry
 Experience contributing to taking III-V devices from concept through design, fabrication and test, ideally including exposure to qualification
 Good understanding of semiconductor laser and amplifier physics: optical gain, carrier dynamics, quantum-well design, noise, gain saturation and nonlinearities, thermal effects and polarisation dependence
 Hands-on knowledge of III-V epitaxy and fabrication processes (e.g. MOCVD/MBE growth, lithography, etching, passivation, metallisation, facet/AR coating), and experience working with external foundries
 Experience characterising amplifiers or lasers, including optical spectrum analysis, gain and noise measurement, wafer-level probing, temperature-controlled testing and test automation
 Experience with simulation and layout tools for photonic devices, such as Lumerical, Photon Design, Crosslight, RSoft, COMSOL, KLayout, L-Edit or Cadence Virtuoso
 Ability to work effectively with colleagues across design, process, test and packaging functions
 Excellent communication skills, critical thinking, attention to detail and self-motivation
 Nice to have 
 Experience integrating III-V active devices with silicon photonics, including coupling design between III-V and silicon waveguides
 Experience mentoring or supervising junior engineers or students
 Experience with reliability testing and failure analysis of III-V devices
 Experience developing PDK building blocks or compact models for active devices
 Programming experience (Python, MATLAB or C++) for simulation, test automation and data analysis
 Knowledge of photonic packaging, including fibre coupling, thermal design and TEC control
 A track record of high-quality patents and research papers

Graduate Engineer – Robotics, Automation & Maintenance (m/f/d) 
 Start your career at JINGDONG Logistics 
 Your degree is nearly finished. Ready to see your knowledge in motion? 
 Join JINGDONG Logistics and take your first career step in automated warehouse logistics. Work with robotics, conveyor technology, and industrial control systems—and help keep hundreds of autonomous guided vehicles (AGVs) operating safely and reliably.
 This entry-level opportunity is aimed at final-year students and recent graduates seeking a practical, hands-on engineering role .
 Your role 
 As part of our technical team, you will support the maintenance, troubleshooting, and improvement of equipment used in our logistics operations. You will apply your engineering knowledge to real technical challenges and build practical experience across mechanical, electrical, and automated systems.
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Supporting preventive maintenance and inspections of automated equipment.
 Investigating faults and assisting with repairs to mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems.
 Helping maintain the reliable operation of warehouse robots and conveyor systems.
 Assisting with equipment installation, testing, and commissioning.
 Using technical drawings, electrical schematics, and diagnostic tools.
 Documenting maintenance work and identifying opportunities to improve equipment performance.
 Following safety procedures and working closely with technical and operations colleagues.
 Your profile 
 You are in the final stages of, or have recently completed, a degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Robotics, or a related discipline .
 You enjoy practical engineering and want to work directly with machinery and automated systems.
 You bring technical foundations from university projects, laboratory work, internships, or personal projects.
 You approach problems systematically and work carefully, independently, and collaboratively.
 Initial knowledge of PLCs, industrial automation, or electrical schematics is welcome.
 You are willing to work in an operational warehouse environment, including shifts and weekend work where required.
 Previous full-time professional experience is not required. 
 What you can look forward to 
 Robotics at scale: A modern warehouse logistics environment with hundreds of AGVs operating simultaneously.
 Practical engineering experience: Direct exposure to robotics, conveyor technology, and industrial equipment.
 Varied technical challenges: Opportunities to develop your maintenance, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills.
 Visible impact: Your contribution helps keep daily logistics operations moving.
 An international team: Collaboration with colleagues from different technical and cultural backgrounds.
 Room to contribute: Opportunities to suggest improvements to equipment reliability and maintenance processes.
 Apply and put your engineering knowledge to work. 
 Please submit your CV, expected graduation date, and earliest possible start date . Feel free to include relevant university projects, internships, or practical technical experience.
 JINGDONG Logistics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds.

items.jobTitle: Supplier Industrialization Engineer, AC charging (m/w/d) - Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg
items.jobDescription:
What To Expect
 Tesla was founded in 2003 with the goal of accelerating the transition to sustainable energy and protecting the planet Earth. Through solar energy, batteries, and electric vehicles, we are building a world of amazing abundance.
At Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg, we manufacture the Model Y, and starting in 2027, we’ll produce everything from battery cells to electric vehicles. This is unique in Europe. Our international team consists of over 12,000 employees from 130 countries. We hire talent at all skill levels - prior experience in the automotive industry is not required. Would you like to help write the next chapter in Tesla’s success story and work at one of Germany’s most modern workplaces? Then this is the right place for you!
Tesla’s Supplier Industrialization team is responsible for critical component development and qualification activities at suppliers. The job involves communicating well with internal and external teams, traveling to suppliers in different regions, and on-the-spot critical decision making. The goal: delivering on time quantities of high-quality component parts into Tesla’s production processes to enable extremely rapid development cycles and product launches.
 What You'll Do
 Plan, organize, direct and conduct industrialization related activities within the supply chain team
 Develop, Manage, Audit and Improve supplier planning and execution of component manufacturing. assembly techniques and quality control processes from the advanced development phase to mass production
 Provide leadership for New Product Introduction (NPI) at Suppliers 
 Lead supplier improvements in scalability, cost, and quality 
 Facilitate communication and clarification of technical requirements between Suppliers, Tesla Purchasing, Quality, and Design teams
 Accountable for supplier audits to ensure their ability to meet part performance, delivery, and reliability expectations
 Collaborate with Tesla Design, Quality, and Manufacturing teams to determine the ideal performance specifications and supplier metrics
 Accountable for leading, tracking, and improving supplier manufacturing processes, as well as ensuring development and launch readiness for new products and design changes to promote efficient and seamless production of high-quality products
 Validate supplier corrective actions involving design and process changes to ensure they are robust, sustainable, and effectively implemented to address similar potential concerns across manufacturing lines and suppliers
 Ownership includes NPI to SOP process for A/C charging products, Mobile Connector, Wall connector, and Adaptors. 
 What You'll Bring
 BS Degree in Electrical / Mechanical / Industrial / Manufacturing Engineering or evidence of experience and exceptional ability
 Knowledge and Experience in Quality Systems: PPAP, APQP, DFM, GD&T, SPC and Solving issues techniques 
 Demonstrate strong leadership abilities
 Previous experience managing safety critical parts, charging products , harness process , Top level assembly and Power distribution commodities
 Ability to communicate and direct supplier activities at the management level to meet requirements and expectations
 Ability to define and execute a project using project management techniques
 Ability to thrive in a fast paced, dynamic environment. Excellent team building skills in dealing with suppliers, peers and other functional areas
 An average of 30 - 40% travel, possibly on short notice
 Candidates are expected to uphold and actively promote sustainability principles in their daily work, operating in line with Tesla Global Environmental, Health, Safety & Security (EHS&S) Policy and EMAS requirements, fostering a culture of continuous environmental improvement
, Tesla

items.jobTitle: Stage – Développement de projets de stockage d’energie par batteries (BESS) (F/H/X)
items.jobDescription:
Localisation
 Poste basé à Avignon  (84). 
 Vous souhaitez découvrir concrètement comment se développent les projets de stockage par batteries et contribuer à la transition énergétique ? Au sein de l’équipe Novar en France, vous serez accompagné·e par les équipes de développement et les supports techniques. Vous participerez, à votre niveau, à l’identification de sites et à la préparation des premières analyses et démarches d’autorisation pour des projets de stockage. Vous accompagnerez également dans leurs missions de développement de projets solaires les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets et les Chef.fe .s de projets.
 Vos missions
 ·         Identification de sites pour des projets de stockage par batteries. Pour cela, un travail d’analyse et de suivi des évolutions techniques et réglementaires devra être réalisé.
 ·         Analyses et prédimensionnement du projet de stockage sur la base des informations collectées (caractéristiques du réseau électrique à proximité ; règles d’urbanismes ; enjeux liés à l’occupation du sol, aux accès, au voisinage et aux zonages environnementaux).
 ·         Préparer des supports de synthèse (recherches documentaires, cartographie et tableaux de suivi) et apprendre à faire ressortir les principaux points à approfondir.
 ·         Accompagner les Chef.fe .s de projet en Développement et les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets dans leurs missions et se familiariser avec les démarches de sécurisation foncière, de développement de projets et de permitting sous leurs supervisions.
 Votre profil
 ·         Bac +5 type Master ou Ingénieur généraliste ou énergie .
 ·         Un intérêt marqué pour les énergies renouvelables, les systèmes électriques et la transition énergétique.
 ·         À l’aise avec la recherche, l’analyse et la synthèse d’informations, ainsi qu’avec la rédaction de documents clairs.
 ·         Rigueur, autonomie, curiosité et esprit d’équipe.
 ·         Bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques ; la connaissance des outils SIG ou de la réglementation en urbanisme et en environnement constitue un plus.
 ·         Bon niveau de français ; la connaissance de l’anglais est appréciée dans notre environnement international.
 Ce que NOVAR vous offre
 Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables.
 Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte? 
 💰 Une gratification de stage de 900 € par mois, dans le respect de la réglementation en vigueur.
 🚆 Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport en commun.
📚 Des opportunités de développement et de croissance au sein de notre scale-up international.
 À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe
 Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 200 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. 
 Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. 
 Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 7 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2035. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain. 
 Intéressé(e) ?
 Prêt(e) pour la prochaine étape de votre carrière ? Postulez dès maintenant via le formulaire de candidature sur notre site internet et contribuez à créer un avenir plus durable !
 Des questions? Contactez Anhelina Skotarenko, notre Corporate Recruiter, au +31 6 27 45 99 35 ou par e-mail à Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

items.jobTitle: Ingénieur IVVQ Software - Logiciel embarqué automobile H/F
items.jobDescription:
Contexte de la mission 
 Dans le cadre des activités de développement et de validation de logiciels embarqués automobiles, la mission consiste à renforcer l’équipe en charge de l’intégration, de la vérification et de la validation logicielle.
Le consultant intervient principalement sur la validation fonctionnelle du logiciel, à travers l’analyse des exigences, la préparation et l’exécution des tests ainsi que l’analyse des résultats. Il contribue à identifier les anomalies, à vérifier leur correction et à garantir la conformité du logiciel aux exigences spécifiées.
Les activités sont majoritairement réalisées sur des environnements de simulation logicielle (MIL/SIL), des environnements de test sur PC ou des plateformes d’intégration logicielle. L’utilisation de bancs HIL reste ponctuelle, lorsque certaines fonctionnalités nécessitent une validation sur cible ou des contraintes temporelles spécifiques.
 Objectifs et activités 
 Le Consultant Aura Pour Principales Responsabilités
 Analyser les exigences logicielles et les spécifications fonctionnelles. 
 Élaborer et maintenir les plans de test, procédures et scénarios de validation logicielle. 
 Réaliser les tests fonctionnels sur les logiciels embarqués, principalement en environnement SIL/MIL ou sur plateforme logicielle. 
 Préparer les environnements de test et configurer les moyens nécessaires à l’exécution des campagnes. 
 Développer et automatiser des scripts de test afin d’améliorer la couverture et la répétabilité des validations. 
 Analyser les résultats de test, identifier les écarts et diagnostiquer les anomalies logicielles. 
 Assurer le suivi des anomalies avec les équipes de développement et vérifier les corrections apportées. 
 Garantir la traçabilité entre les exigences, les cas de test, les résultats et les anomalies. 
 Participer aux activités d’intégration continue et à l’exécution automatisée des tests dans les pipelines CI/CD. 
 Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des méthodes, outils et processus de validation. 
 Intervenir ponctuellement sur banc HIL lorsque les tests nécessitent une validation sur calculateur réel, des échanges réseau ou des contraintes temps réel. 
 Compétences requises 
 IVVQ logiciel et méthodologie de test : confirmé 
 Validation fonctionnelle de logiciels embarqués : confirmé 
 Analyse d’exigences et conception de cas de test : confirmé 
 Langage Python et/ou scripting pour l’automatisation des tests : confirmé 
 C/C++ et compréhension du logiciel embarqué : bonnes connaissances 
 Environnements de simulation MIL/SIL et tests sur PC : appréciés 
 Git et gestion de versions : bonnes connaissances 
 Intégration continue CI/CD et outils d’automatisation : appréciés 
 Analyse et diagnostic d’anomalies logicielles : confirmé 
 Environnement automobile et systèmes embarqués : appréciés 
 Connaissance des protocoles de communication embarqués (CAN, LIN, Ethernet) : appréciée 
 Connaissance de Matlab/simulink : appréciés 
 Profil recherché 
 Ingénieur en informatique, logiciel embarqué, systèmes électroniques ou domaine équivalent.

Graduate Programme — Babyzone
 Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life?  
 Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses? 
 Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a tech company is built, and be supported while taking ownership of work that matters?  
 If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you!
 We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to Babyzone, one of the social-impact organisations supported by BC.
 ABOUT US 
 At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more. We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets - ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.
 Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees to support their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.
 We work closely with investment and strategic partners ranging from Paypal, FIS, L&G, Tencent, Experian, Google, WorldPay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.
 Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to the best practice tools, solutions, and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new business get off the ground, including technology, growth (marketing and sales), talent, finance, legal and tax.
  IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT 
 15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust, Babyzone and Onside Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.
 ABOUT BABYZONE
 Babyzone is an innovative and fast-growing UK early childhood charity. It runs free, open-access community hubs for families with children aged 0-5 in areas of high deprivation, bringing together services, programmes and partners to improve outcomes for young children and their families.
   THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY 
 Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with Babyzone. You will be embedded within the Babyzone team and contribute to meaningful projects that support the charity's growth, operations and impact, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.
 For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:
 Dedicated to Babyzone – although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Babyzone. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Babyzone and its mission, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-growing, mission-led organisation.
 Training & Development – we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Babyzone. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Babyzone team.
 Early Careers Development – as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your role itself remains fully dedicated to Babyzone.
 Graduate Community – you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Babyzone.
 Accountability – you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Babyzone, seeing the direct impact of your work on the organisation and the families and communities it serves.
 ARE YOU BC?  
 We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience. As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline – different areas of expertise are great for new perspectives. 
 We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:
 Curious  – people in BC are inquisitive, they want to understand ‘why’ and consider if there is a better approach rather than take on the ‘it’s how we’ve always done it’ perspective. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.
 ‘Doers’  – surprisingly, this is not a given in a lot of working environments; we are a community of pro-active self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, though we do look for proactive people who can use their initiative and drive on a daily basis. Working in an environment where everyone has this trait is incredibly refreshing and we strive to maintain it.
 Flexible Mindset –  working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital for us.
 Enthusiasm –  you do not need to be a ‘techy’ at heart to work in our environment. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about what digitalisation is doing to industries and a drive to work in a pioneering sector which represents that drive. A desire for doing new and challenging things makes coming into work a whole lot more fun.
 Humble & Sociable  – building a tech start-up is never easy. As such, we have a ‘no-ego’ policy and seek out people who bring energy to a team, not drain it. We have a down-to-earth and personable culture; we solve complex problems but do not take ourselves too seriously and look to have fun whilst doing so.
 If you see yourself in this and would like to work with similarly minded people, we would love to hear from you!
 WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU AS A BC EMPLOYEE:
 Be part of the UK’s leading digital venture builder and have the opportunity to be a part of and learn from the incredible talent in BC
 Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities while building deep, hands-on experience within Babyzone
 A fun and open, if a little cricket obsessed, atmosphere
 Discretionary bonus
 25 days of paid holidays + your birthday off
 Life Assurance, Pension Scheme, Cycle to Work Scheme
 Flexible Benefits including Private Medical and Dental, Gym Subsidiaries
 APPLICATION & PROCESS 
 If you are keen to apply, please submit your CV and a member of our Talent Team will contact you with next steps. We have a rigorous recruitment process, which we use for all our roles to ensure we attract the very best talent. 
 We have a three-stage process that will consist of the following:
 Stage 1: Telephone interview with a member of the BC Talent team
 Stage 2:  Virtual assessment day, consisting of both individual and group activities
 Stage 3: Final interviews with Blenheim Chalcot and Babyzone at Scale Space, White City
 *Please note the timeframes provided above are subject to change, which we will communicate throughout the process* 
 Blenheim Chalcot is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values, thus making it core to our business. We strive to maximise the diversity of our workforce and welcome applications from everyone. We encourage diversity through perspective, background, identity, and thought whilst also fostering an environment where everyone can express themselves regardless of your race, religion, sex, gender, colour, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We are committed to continuing to nurture an inclusive environment and building a diverse workforce. 
 By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role.  This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for.  You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing   here .

termios builds smart thermostats for real estate. Our product — termios Pro — replaces standard radiator thermostats in existing buildings, performs hydraulic balancing via a self-learning algorithm, and cuts heating energy consumption by up to 30%. No battery, no retrofitting: the device harvests energy from the temperature differential between radiator and room air (thermo-harvesting) and communicates over LoRaWAN.
 The system runs at scale across multi-unit residential portfolios. Each thermostat is a constrained embedded device operating autonomously, syncing state through a LoRaWAN gateway to a cloud backend that runs the optimization logic. We're 35 people, growing, and the firmware team is small — your work ships directly to devices in real apartments.
 Tasks 
 The firmware running on our smart thermostats — from first commit to field rollout. You write code, solder, measure, debug. No handoffs to someone else when it gets hard.
 Thermostat firmware development and optimization
 LoRaWAN communication stack (implementation + maintenance)
 Low-power / energy harvesting optimization
 OTA update mechanisms
 Automated Hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure (build, operate, extend)
 Release process, Definition of Done, RED/CRA compliance
 Field monitoring dashboards and post-rollout quality
 Requirements 
 Must-haves: 
 5+ years embedded/firmware development in C / C embedded
 ARM Cortex-M architecture (bare-metal and/or RTOS)
 Experience in Low-power design and energy efficiency
 Knowledge of common communication protocols such as UART, I2C, SPI and hardware debugging: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzer, oscilloscope
 Python for test automation and data analysis
 Embedded security fundamentals
 Degree in related engineering field
 Nice-to-have: 
 LoRaWAN hands-on (SX127x/SX126x, ChirpStack)
 NXP MCUXpresso SDK and toolchain
 Experience in other main-stream programming languages like Python, Go or Algol 68
 OverTheAirUpdate in embedded context
 Regulatory background (RED, CRA)
 IoT in building tech or energy sector
 Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. 
 Benefits 
 Remote-friendly, output-driven company
 Flexible working hours
 regular team-events
 dynamic tech-startup culture
 Urban Sports and Corporate Benefits
 We are a 35-person company — short path to decision-makers, real ownership
 Hard problems: thermo management, energy harvesting, LoRaWAN at scale, OTA in the field
 Every line of code runs on real devices in real homes and make real change.
 No cover letter. CV + GitHub / project links if available.

 Assemble and integrate Thermal Protection System (TPS) hardware, including skin panels, access panels, TPS tiles, and associated mechanical interfaces.

Electronics & Robotics Hardware Engineer (m/f/d) 
 Olive Robotics GmbH · Ottobrunn, Munich area, Germany 
 Full-time or half-time · On-site 
 About Olive Robotics 
 At Olive Robotics, we develop embedded sensors and robotic systems that connect intelligent software with the physical world. We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who enjoys designing, assembling, testing, and improving hardware. Your work will span electronics development, mechanical CAD, prototyping, and production—helping turn ideas into reliable products.
 Your responsibilities 
 Develop and improve electronic hardware, including schematics, PCB layouts, component selection, and board bring-up.
 Assemble prototypes and products, including soldering, SMD rework, cable preparation, wiring, and mechanical assembly.
 Design enclosures, brackets, fixtures, and other mechanical parts using 3D CAD.
 Integrate PCBs, sensors, embedded controllers, connectors, and mechanical components into complete systems.
 Develop test setups and procedures for functional testing, calibration, and reliability assessment.
 Troubleshoot hardware issues using measurements, structured fault analysis, and practical experimentation.
 Support the transition from prototypes to repeatable production, improving assembly processes, test coverage, and product quality.
 Maintain clear documentation, including BOMs, design files, assembly instructions, and test reports.
 Work with suppliers and manufacturing partners on component sourcing, fabrication, and technical questions.
 Your profile 
 Demonstrated practical experience developing, assembling, and debugging electronic hardware.
 Confident use of soldering and rework equipment, oscilloscopes, multimeters, and laboratory power supplies.
 Experience with electronic design tools such as KiCad, Altium, or comparable software.
 Experience with 3D CAD tools such as Fusion 360, or comparable software.
 Understanding of component datasheets, electronic interfaces, manufacturing tolerances, and design for assembly.
 A careful, organized approach to work, with clear documentation and attention to detail.
 The ability to take responsibility for a task, communicate progress, and follow issues through to resolution.
 Comfortable communicating in English and working on-site in Ottobrunn.
 A degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, or a related field—or relevant vocational training and equivalent practical experience—is welcome. What matters most is evidence of hardware you have built and made work. 
 Useful additional experience 
 Embedded systems, microcontrollers, and interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, USB, or Ethernet.
 Sensors, IMUs, robotics, or electromechanical systems.
 Python or C/C++ for test automation and hardware bring-up.
 EMC testing, environmental testing, or product certification.
 Small-series production, quality control, and manufacturing process improvement.
 What we offer 
 Broad technical ownership across electronics, mechanical integration, testing, and production.
 Close collaboration with the founders and engineering team.
 The opportunity to see your work become part of real sensor and robotics products.
 A small team where practical ideas and improvements can directly shape product development.
 A full-time or half-time position based at our office and engineering workspace in Ottobrunn.
 How to apply 
 Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV and a few examples of relevant work. Project photos, PCB designs, CAD models, test setups, or a short description of your contribution are welcome. Please share only material you are authorized to disclose. 
 Include your earliest possible start date and whether you are interested in full-time or half-time employment.

items.jobTitle: Staff Software Engineer, Vehicle Configuration Platform
items.jobDescription:
About Us
 Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.
The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.
 Role Summary
 A single firmware release must serve every vehicle variant we build across both Rivian and all Volkswagen brands. The vehicle configuration platform that the OTA team supports makes that possible: a schema-driven system that defines every configurable attribute of a vehicle and provisions them onto vehicles in the factory, in service, and over the air customer updates. Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service.
You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. You will set technical direction for this surface area, drive initiatives that span firmware, build infrastructure, release engineering, OTA, and factory integration across two companies' engineering organizations, and raise the bar for how the team designs, reviews, and ships.
This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.
 Responsibilities
 Own the technical direction for configuration tooling, validation, and delivery infrastructure, translating platform architecture into a concrete, sequenced roadmap and driving it to completion across teams.
 Lead initiatives that simplify the platform: consolidating redundant mechanisms, retiring legacy pathways, and reducing the coordination cost of routine changes, while every downstream consumer keeps working.
 Design the compatibility strategy for data contracts deployed to devices in the field, and build the automated enforcement that makes schema evolution provably safe rather than carefully reviewed.
 Architect the validation and release pipeline as a product: define what classes of defects must be impossible to merge, and build the layered checks, staged rollouts, and observability that get there.
 Serve as the senior escalation point for production configuration issues, leading root cause analysis during launches and field events and converting each incident into systemic prevention.
 Drive alignment across organizational boundaries, negotiating shared contracts, review processes, and release mechanics with firmware, cloud, diagnostics, manufacturing, and partner-brand stakeholders who have differing constraints and conventions.
 Mentor and multiply the engineers on the team, setting standards through design review, raising the quality of technical writing and decision records, and growing the mid-level engineers toward ownership.
 Be accountable for the long-term maintenance cost of what the team ships.
 Qualifications
 Minimum Qualifications:
 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing system used by many teams.
 A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from proposal through delivery, including ones that required deprecating or migrating away from entrenched systems.
 Deep experience with serialization formats such as Protocol Buffers, including designing schemas with strict backward and forward compatibility guarantees for devices you cannot force-update.
 Strong Python and working C literacy; real depth in a modern build system such as Bazel, including writing rules and repository-level integration, not just consuming builds.
 Mature CI/CD and release engineering judgment: you design validation gates and rollout mechanics that encode correctness in automation, and you know which guarantees belong in tooling versus process.
 Sound judgment under production pressure: you can lead a time-critical fix during a vehicle launch, and you also know when to refuse a shortcut or fence one in and drive its removal afterward.
 Excellent written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to non-software audiences and to write decision documents that hold up over time.
 The instinct to lead through leverage: you measure your impact by what the team and its users can do without you.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Automotive or embedded domain experience: UDS diagnostics, vehicle variant coding, factory provisioning, or OTA update systems.
 Rust experience.
 Experience operating in multi-company or partner-engineering environments with separate review and release processes.
 Experience with code generation toolchains such as protoc plugins or template-based generators.
 Familiarity with manifest-based multi-repository workflows.
 Total Rewards
 We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.
Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.
In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs .
 External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site ( https://rivianvw.tech/#careers ). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board .
 Equal Opportunity
Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status.
Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.
Candidate Data Privacy
Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) record keeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.
Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies affiliates; and (iii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies’ service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.
Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.
If you provide a mobile telephone number as part of your application or during the recruitment process, Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use that number to contact you via SMS text message for recruitment-related purposes, including scheduling, logistics, and status updates. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of SMS communications at any time by replying STOP to any text message you receive from us. Consent to receive SMS messages is not a condition of applying for or being considered for employment.
Please see our Candidate Data Privacy Notice (English) and Candidate Data Privacy Notice (Serbian) for more information.

# 
Die E.ON Drive Germany GmbH ist das Rückgrat des deutschen E-Mobilitätsgeschäfts und repräsentiert die Marke E.ON Drive. Wir bringen erneuerbare Energie auf die Straße und unterstützen Privatpersonen und Unternehmen in ganz Deutschland dabei, mit Elektromobilität sauber, leise und günstig unterwegs zu sein. Unser Produktportfolio umfasst intelligente Lösungen für das Laden auf der Straße, am Arbeitsplatz und zu Hause. Wir helfen unseren Kunden bei jedem Schritt, von der persönlichen Beratung, der Installation von Ladestationen, modernen Abrechnungssystemen bis hin zur Lieferung von Ökostrom.
# 
Deine Mission
Im Team „Customer Solution Planning“ entwickelst und verantwortest du die elektrotechnische Planung sowie den Netzanschluss von Batteriespeichersystemen (BESS) im Gewerbe-, Industrie- und Utility-Scale-Umfeld. Projekt- und Vermarktungsanforderungen übersetzt du in sichere, wirtschaftliche und genehmigungsfähige technische Lösungen und begleitest unsere Projekte von der frühen Machbarkeitsbewertung über Netzanschluss und Zertifizierung bis zur Inbetriebnahme. Dabei bildest du die zentrale technische Schnittstelle zwischen Sales, Planning, Project Management, Netzbetreibern, Zertifizierungsstellen, Lieferanten und ausführenden Partnern.
Dein Spielfeld
Netzanschluss und Anschlusskonzepte entwickeln
Du bewertest Netzanschlusspunkte und Anschlussvarianten auf Nieder- und Mittelspannungsebene sowie, bei entsprechendem Projektumfang, an der Schnittstelle zur Hochspannung. Netzanschlussanfragen, Anschlusskonzepte und technische Abstimmungen mit Verteil- und Übertragungsnetzbetreibern steuerst du fachlich und führst offene Punkte bis zur belastbaren Anschlusszusage
Mittelspannung, Netzstudien und Schutz auslegen
Transformatoren, Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen, Übergabestationen, Kabelanlagen, Erdungs- und Blitzschutzkonzepte sowie Mess- und Zählerkonzepte werden von dir dimensioniert und spezifiziert. Du erstellst oder koordinierst Lastfluss-, Kurzschluss-, Selektivitäts- und Schutzbetrachtungen sowie Bewertungen zu Blindleistung, Spannungsqualität, Oberschwingungen und Einspeisemanagement und stimmst Schutzkonzepte und Einstellwerte mit Netzbetreibern, Zertifizierern und Inbetriebnahmeverantwortlichen ab
BESS-Systemdesign technisch bewerten
Systemarchitekturen aus Batteriecontainern beziehungsweise Racks, Power Conversion System (PCS), Transformatoren, Energy Management System beziehungsweise Power Plant Controller (EMS/PPC), Hilfsenergieversorgung, Kommunikation und Leittechnik bewertest du unter Berücksichtigung von Leistungs- und Energiedimensionierung, Wirkungsgraden, Degradation, Verfügbarkeit, Regelungsanforderungen, Redundanzen und Erweiterbarkeit. Herstellerunterlagen, Planungsänderungen und Ausführungskonzepte prüfst du auf Sicherheit, Selektivität, Netzkonformität, Betriebsfähigkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit
Planungs-, Ausschreibungs- und Vergabeunterlagen erstellen
Du erarbeitest technische Spezifikationen, Single-Line-Diagramme, Datenblätter, Mengengerüste, Schnittstellenlisten und Leistungsverzeichnisse. Angebote und technische Abweichungen von BESS-, PCS-, Transformator-, Schaltanlagen- und EPC-Anbietern prüfst du strukturiert und leitest daraus klare Vergabeempfehlungen ab
Zertifizierung und Netzkonformität sicherstellen
Anlagenzertifizierungs- und Konformitätsnachweisprozesse, unter anderem nach VDE-AR-N 4110 beziehungsweise 4120, NELEV sowie den einschlägigen FGW-Richtlinien, planst und koordinierst du über den Projektverlauf. Nachweise, Modelle, Komponenten- und Einheitenzertifikate führst du frühzeitig zusammen und steuerst Abweichungen und Auflagen bis zum Abschluss
Umsetzung, Inbetriebnahme und technische Schnittstellen begleiten
Während Detailplanung und Bau unterstützt du technische Klärungen, begleitest Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) sowie Schutz-, Kommunikations- und Funktionstests und wirkst bei der Inbetriebsetzungserklärung und den Nachweisen gegenüber dem Netzbetreiber mit. Dabei führst du die Schnittstellen zwischen Batterie, PCS, EMS/PPC, Netzanschluss, Brandschutz, Bau und Betrieb zusammen, dokumentierst Annahmen, Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar und sorgst für vollständige Übergaben an Project Management, Construction, Commissioning und Operations. Erkenntnisse aus den Projekten überführst du in Standards und wiederverwendbare Planungslösungen
Bist Du unser Playmaker?
Technische Qualifikation
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektro-, Energie- oder Automatisierungstechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung
Berufserfahrung
Idealerweise bringst du mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in Netzanschluss, Mittelspannung, Energieanlagen oder BESS-Projekten mit. Entscheidend ist, dass du komplexe Netzanschluss- und Systemfragen eigenständig fachlich verantworten kannst
Netzanschluss, Mittelspannung und Schutztechnik
Mit Netzanschlussverfahren, Mittelspannung und Schutztechnik bist du ebenso vertraut wie mit den Abläufen von Anschluss- und Zertifizierungsverfahren
BESS- und Systemverständnis
Das Zusammenspiel von Batterietechnologie, PCS, EMS/PPC, Transformator, Schaltanlage, Schutz- und Leittechnik ist dir vertraut. Kenntnisse zu Netzdienstleistungen, Wirkleistungs- und Blindleistungsregelung, Schwarzstart- oder Inselnetzanwendungen sind ein Plus
Technische Planung und Dokumentation
Single-Line-Diagramme, Schutzkonzepte, technische Spezifikationen und Herstellerunterlagen kannst du sicher lesen, erstellen und prüfen
Projekt- und Partnersteuerung
Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Netzbetreibern, Zertifizierungsstellen, Fachplanern, Lieferanten und EPC-Partnern bringst du mit. Technische Anforderungen kannst du in klare Arbeitspakete, Prüfkommentare und Entscheidungen übersetzen und bewertest Lösungen neben Funktion und Kosten auch hinsichtlich sicherer Betriebsführung, Instandhaltbarkeit, Nachweisführung und langfristiger Verfügbarkeit
So bringst Du Dich ins Spiel
Struktur und Eigenverantwortung
Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, priorisierst technische Risiken und verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent bis zur belastbaren Klärung

items.jobTitle: Staff Machine Learning Engineer (TLM), Driver Understanding and Evaluation
items.jobDescription:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.
 The DUE Machine Learning team will build and operate scalable machine learning and data systems, simulation workflow and insight tools, improve and speed up the evaluation and onboard developer journeys. It will combine expert human judgements and advanced machine learning models to deliver training and evaluation data for hundreds of metrics and components that make up the Waymo driver. 
 We are planning to set up a team in London UK to work with the teams in MTV and Oxford to build these foundation models out and to integrate them into several evaluation and training products. We are looking for researchers and software engineers who are passionate about developing machine learning techniques for the Evaluation systems on our autonomous vehicles, and have an incessant drive to improve the performance of our technology stack.
 In this hybrid role, you will report to an Engineering Manager.
 You will: 
 Be part of a world class research engineering team to grow the state-of-the-art of ultra realistic AV simulations using foundation models
 Collaborate with teams in Waymo Oxford to use large models to improve sim realism
 Design experiments that push the frontiers of AV simulations
 Develop metrics that measure the realism of simulated worlds
 Train and evaluate large models and integrate them into the simulator and its downstream applications
 Help hire outstanding research engineers from diverse backgrounds
 Be a part of a collaborative research engineering team that takes research ideas and productionizes them
 1+ years of people management experience
 We prefer: 
 7+ years experience in applied Deep Learning
 7+ years coding and design skills
 Experience solving complex production problems using state-of-the-art ML techniques
 Experience taking research to production
 Expertise in Data Analysis or Data Science
 The expected base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level.  Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements. 
 Salary Range £155,000 — £163,000 GBP Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver.
